 2 die of dengue, 1,255 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 483 this year 
 Published : 13 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 13 November 2026, 16:54
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least two dengue patients died and 1,255 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 The two deaths were reported in Dhaka division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the death toll this year has risen to 483, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 158,883.
 Currently, 5,915 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
